info.title: The Fated Magical Princess: Who Made Me a Princess
info.synopsis: La bella Athanasia è stata uccisa per mano di suo padre, Claude de Alger Obelia, l’imperatore dal sangue freddo. Sembrerebbe solo una sciocca storia della buonanotte… fino a quando una donna si sveglia e scopre improvvisamente di essere diventata quella sfortunata principessa! Ha bisogno di un piano per sopravvivere al suo destino già deciso e il tempo sta per scadere. Andrà con il Piano A, vivrà il più silenziosamente possibile senza farsi notare dal famigerato imperatore? Piano B, raccogliere abbastanza soldi per sfuggire al palazzo? O imboccherà il Piano C, farsi strada tra le grazie del padre?!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Athanasia was born a princess of the Obelia Empire. A prophetic dream shows her a future where she is banished by her merciless father, Emperor Claude. From a very young age, Athanasia refuses to accept that future. To change her fate, she begins fighting it fiercely, using her intelligence and charm as weapons. Amidst all that, a maid is seen behaving rather suspiciously in the palace.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: As part of her plan to escape her fate, Athanasia continues to gather valuables from around the palace. But the recent incident has prompted increased security and an inspection of all the rooms! Athanasia looks for somewhere safe to hide her treasures and finds a building that looks empty. It seems perfect, but when she goes to hide her treasures, she runs into the last person she wants to see!

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Lilian and Athanasia are summoned to an audience with Claude where he informs them that he will oversee Athanasia's wellbeing from now on. The last thing Athanasia wants is to attract his attention, but he insists on having tea together. He's always been so cold toward her. Why is he so interested now? Is it all part of the tragic fate she's trying to escape?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Athanasia notices that Claude's face, and the faces of those around him, grow grim at any mention of her mother, Diana. One day at tea, Athanasia expresses her opinion of her tea. Hearing her words, Claude leaves their tea party. It seems that her opinion is exactly the same as one that her mother once gave. Will the relationship between father and daughter grow distant once more?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Duke Alpheus suddenly shows up at the palace. In Athanasia's dreams, he's an ambitious man who uses Jennette to advance his own position. Alarmed at the fact that things have started happening differently than in her dreams, Athanasia finds an ancient book that will help her in practicing magic. When she begins her training, the mysterious great wizard Lucas appears before her with a warning.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Athanasia falls into a coma from which Lucas saves her. She is told that she collapsed because her magical energy overflowed, and she's given highly skilled tutors to help her learn to control her magic, but she shows no signs of improvement. Then, she makes a certain deal with Lucas.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Athanasia starts her magical training with Lucas, but she shows no signs of improvement at all. She grows dissatisfied with Lucas' teaching methods and begins comparing him with Duke Alpheus' son Ijikiel. Lucas says, "If you're so interested in him, then...," and uses his magic to send Athanasia to Ijikiel.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Athanasia's regrets about the way she left Ijikiel prompt her to ask Lucas to send her back to the duke's house. In the midst of her conversation with Ijikiel, a girl with the same jeweled eyes as Athanasia appears—Jennette. In Athanasia's dreams, Jennette was the heir to the Obelia Empire, beloved by her father, Claude, and everyone around her. Complicated feelings stir within Athanasia's heart.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: In the Obelia Empire, when children turn fourteen, they debut into society, which involves performing a dance in a public space. But in her heart, Athanasia has a different partner she'd like to dance with.

info.title: The Fated Magical Princess: Who Made Me a Princess
info.synopsis: La bella Athanasia è stata uccisa per mano di suo padre, Claude de Alger Obelia, l’imperatore dal sangue freddo. Sembrerebbe solo una sciocca storia della buonanotte… fino a quando una donna si sveglia e scopre improvvisamente di essere diventata quella sfortunata principessa! Ha bisogno di un piano per sopravvivere al suo destino già deciso e il tempo sta per scadere. Andrà con il Piano A, vivrà il più silenziosamente possibile senza farsi notare dal famigerato imperatore? Piano B, raccogliere abbastanza soldi per sfuggire al palazzo? O imboccherà il Piano C, farsi strada tra le grazie del padre?!
